descriptions.d20f_list_element_802b8be0: Creates the owner's missing 140-byte list element: derives an inset from the owner scale, the element width from the context extent minus margin and inset, and the text size (context value or measured text when zero); allocates and constructs the element, hands it the two retained interfaces, length, selection, layer, value, height and property, stores the size, positions it at the inset-adjusted offset and runs its setup. An existing element only refreshes its selection. Field names describe observed use only.
